# Noble Dental Care - Knowledge Graph & Context

## About Noble Dental Care
Noble Dental Care is a premium dental clinic located in Nallagandla, Hyderabad, specializing in advanced dental treatments, implants, and microscopic endodontics. Led by Dr. Dhivakaran, we provide evidence-based care with state-of-the-art technology.

## Core Services
- Dental Implants (Titanium & Zirconia)
- Microscopic Root Canal Treatment
- Invisalign & Braces
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Cosmetic Dentistry (Veneers, Smile Design)
- Full Mouth Rehabilitation
